recipe.title: Crispy Glazed Tamari Tofu over Fragrant Garlic Rice
recipe.description: Pan-seared extra-firm tofu coated in a rich, sweet and savory gluten-free soy glaze, served atop light, aromatic garlic-infused jasmine rice.

ingredients.item: Extra-firm tofu (pressed and cut into 1-inch cubes)

instructions.text: Combine rinsed jasmine rice and 1.5 cups water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let rest covered for 10 minutes.
Press tofu with paper towels to absorb excess moisture. Gently toss the cubed tofu in cornstarch until each piece is evenly coated.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gluten-free soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, grated ginger, and 1 clove of minced garlic to create the reduction glaze.
Heat avocado oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add tofu cubes in a single layer and pan-fry for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally until all sides are deep golden and crispy.

In a small pan over low heat, warm the sesame oil and remaining 2 cloves of minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant. Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and gently stir in the warm garlic-sesame oil and half of the green onions.
Turn the skillet with the tofu down to low heat. Pour the prepared soy sauce glaze over the crispy tofu and toss gently for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the tofu in a glossy glaze.
Divide the garlic rice between two serving bowls, top with the crispy glazed tofu, and garnish with toasted sesame seeds and remaining green onions.

tips: Always double-check labels to ensure your soy sauce is certified gluten-free (Tamari is a great naturally gluten-free option).
Thoroughly pressing moisture out of the tofu is the secret to getting a golden, extra-crispy exterior without deep frying.
